content:
"The search for an Indian tourist who fell into a sudden pavement collapse in Kuala Lumpur has stalled after rescuers judged further efforts too hazardous. Vijaya Lakshmi Gali vanished on 23 August after the ground opened beneath her, and she was believed to have dropped into an 8-metre-deep sinkhole. Only her slippers have been recovered so far.

Rescue teams used tracker dogs, remote cameras and ground-penetrating radar while also flushing portions of the underground drainage with high-pressure water jets. Excavators removed debris and two divers attempted to enter early in the operation but were pulled out when conditions proved unsafe before they could overcome an obstacle.

Officials cited concerns for the safety and health of personnel, along with difficult conditions underground and a prior soil slip reported at the same location last year. Dr Zaliha Mustafa, a minister in the prime minister’s department, explained these factors contributed to pausing the search.

* Authorities have halted risky entry attempts, continuing to rely on remote and surface techniques while evaluating safer options.

*** 
Is there anything else I can help with?"
